text.p: ServiceMaster LP said Friday its $300 million dual-tranche debt offering was priced and proceeds will be used to refinance debt.

The first tranche, $100 million of 6.95 percent notes, was priced to yield 6.99 percent and is due August 15, 2007. The second tranche, $200 million of 7.45 percent notes, was priced to yield 7.47 percent and is due August 15, 2027.
The notes will be issued by ServiceMaster Co, a direct subsidiary of ServiceMaster, and will be guaranteed by ServiceMaster.
The proceeds from the offering of the notes will be used to refinance borrowings under bank credit facilities, thereby reducing the company's exposure to short-term interest rate fluctuations.
Underwriters are led by J.P. Morgan & Co.; Goldman, Sachs & Co.; BancAmerica Securities Inc.; First Chicago Capital Markets Inc.; and NationsBanc Capital Markets Inc.
ServiceMaster provides consumer services including TruGreen-ChemLawn and Terminix, and facilities management services for health care, education, and business and industrial buildings.
